import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class MinCostMaxFlow {
    static class Edge {
        int from, to;
        long cap, cost, flow;
        Edge(int from, int to, long cap, long cost) {
            this.from = from;
            this.to = to;
            this.cap = cap;
            this.cost = cost;
            this.flow = 0;
        }
    }

    static final int maxn = 5007;
    static final long INF = 1000000000L;
    static List<Edge> edges = new ArrayList<>();
    static List<Integer>[] g = new ArrayList[maxn];
    static long[] d = new long[maxn], phi = new long[maxn];
    static int[] par = new int[maxn];

    static {
        for (int i = 0; i < maxn; i++) {
            g[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        }
    }

    static void addEdge(int u, int v, long cap, long cost) {
        g[u].add(edges.size());
        edges.add(new Edge(u, v, cap, cost));
        g[v].add(edges.size());
        edges.add(new Edge(v, u, 0, -cost));
    }

    static void fordBellman(int s, int n) {
        Arrays.fill(phi, INF);
        phi[s] = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < edges.size(); j++) {
                Edge e = edges.get(j);
                if (e.cap == e.flow) continue;
                int from = e.from;
                int to = e.to;
                long len = e.cost;
                if (phi[from] == INF) continue;
                phi[to] = Math.min(phi[to], phi[from] + len);
            }
        }
    }

    static void dijkstra(int s) {
        Arrays.fill(d, INF);
        d[s] = 0;
        PriorityQueue<long[]> q = new PriorityQueue<>(Comparator.comparingLong(a -> a[0]));
        q.offer(new long[]{0, s});
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            long[] cur = q.poll();
            long dist = cur[0];
            int v = (int) cur[1];
            if (dist > d[v]) continue;
            for (int eid : g[v]) {
                Edge e = edges.get(eid);
                if (e.cap == e.flow) continue;
                int to = e.to;
                long len = e.cost + phi[v] - phi[to];
                if (d[v] + len < d[to]) {
                    d[to] = d[v] + len;
                    par[to] = eid;
                    q.offer(new long[]{d[to], to});
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static long[] minCostMaxFlow(int s, int t) {
        fordBellman(s, 50);
        dijkstra(s);
        long flow = 0, cost = 0;
        while (true) {
            if (d[t] == INF) break;
            long pushed = INF, sum = 0;
            for (int tmp = t; tmp != s; tmp = edges.get(par[tmp]).from) {
                int eid = par[tmp];
                pushed = Math.min(pushed, edges.get(eid).cap - edges.get(eid).flow);
                sum += edges.get(eid).cost;
            }
            flow += pushed;
            cost += pushed * sum;
            for (int tmp = t; tmp != s; tmp = edges.get(par[tmp]).from) {
                int eid = par[tmp];
                edges.get(eid).flow += pushed;
                edges.get(eid ^ 1).flow -= pushed;
            }
            dijkstra(s);
            for (int i = 0; i < maxn; i++) {
                phi[i] = d[i];
            }
        }
        return new long[]{cost, flow};
    }

    public static void solve() {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        int m = sc.nextInt();
        int k = sc.nextInt();
        int c = sc.nextInt();
        int d = sc.nextInt();

        int[] cnts = new int[n];
        for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
            int ai = sc.nextInt();
            ai--;
            cnts[ai]++;
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            addEdge(5000, i, cnts[i], 0);
        }

        for (int it = 0; it < m; it++) {
            int u = sc.nextInt() - 1;
            int v = sc.nextInt() - 1;
            for (int i = 0; i < 99; i++) {
                long costVal = d;
                for (int j = 0; j < 50; j++) {
                    addEdge(u + i * 50, v + (i + 1) * 50, 1, costVal);
                    addEdge(v + i * 50, u + (i + 1) * 50, 1, costVal);
                    costVal += 2L * d;
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i <= 99; i++) {
            addEdge(0 + i * 50, 5001, INF, c * i);
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < 99; j++) {
                addEdge(i + j * 50, i + (j + 1) * 50, INF, 0);
            }
        }

        long[] p = minCostMaxFlow(5000, 5001);
        assert p[1] == k;
        System.out.println(p[0]);
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        solve();
    }
}
